page.overview:
Who is Phantom Bison?

Even though he is in a non-corporeal state, his megalomaniacal personality remains the same, still having his like of world domination and dislikes of weak people and incompetent underlings.

His Street Fighter V profile states that at the end of the Story Mode, after Bison's body was destroyed by Ryu, his consciousness remained, turning to an incorporeal form.

Phantom Bison also appeared as an opponent in Falke's character story.

Attempting to resurrect their fallen master, remnants of Shadaloo conduct experiments in the Ruined Lab collecting Psycho Power with the machinery that remains in the lab. Enlisting the help of the Avatar, they succeed in bringing forth a manifestation of Phantom Bison in the form of a large hologram composed of Psycho Power and various fragments of his memory (represented by clips and screenshots of previous games in the Street Fighter series). But at that same time, the Mysterious Man resembling Bison enters the lab and challenges the Phantom. In a battle of power and wills, the Phantom is absorbed by the amnesiac Bison, regaining his fractured lost memories as a result.
